question.problem: Find the solution to the equation ${e}^{8x}=\sqrt{5}$ rounded to $3$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
First, we take $ln$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}{e}^{8x} & =\sqrt{5} \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡({e}^{8x}) & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(\sqrt{5}) \\ 8x & =\operatorname{ln}⁡({5}^{1/2})\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the power rule to the right-hand side and solve for $x$:

$$
\begin{aligned}8x & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(5) \\ x & =\frac{1}{16}\operatorname{ln}⁡(5)\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating the above expression using a calculator gives

$$
x≈0.101
$$

rounded to $3$ decimal places.
